senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. next w.) [to spread,] to shine, sparkle, rise (cmp. הָנֵץ).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 91b:5">Ḥull. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>וכי שמש … זָרְחָה</he> did the sun rise for him (Jacob) alone? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:8:2">Y. Snh. VIII, end, 26ᶜ</cite> <he>החמה זוֹרַחַת וכי …</he> does the sun shine on him (the thief) alone? a. fr.—Tanḥ. Tsav 13, a. fr. <he>צרעת זרחה וכ׳</he> leprosy broke out on &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:12">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>ה׳ לו הצרעת</he> the Lord made leprosy glisten on his face.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ … חמה</he> he caused the globe of the sun to shine bright for him (a sign of pardon).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:1">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, beg. <he>דיין שהקב״ה מַזְרִיחַ וכ׳</he> it is reward enough for them that the Lord lets the sun rise &c.

<cite ref="Makkot 10a:15">Macc. 10ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>מזרחה</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:41">Deut. IV, 41</cite>) <he>הַזְרֵחַ שמש וכ׳</he> let the sun shine on unwilling manslayers (give them safety).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:7">Shebi. IV, 7</cite> <he>משיַזְרִיחוּ</he> (Ms. M. <he>משהִזְ׳</he>) when the young figs begin to glisten.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61">Gen. R. s. 61</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 25:6">Gen. XXV, 6</cite>) <he>כל מה … להַזְרִיחַ תַּזְרִיחוּ</he> go as far east as you can.
